exposure: Intrathecal magnesium sulfate added to levobupivacaine
outcome: Onset and duration of sensory and motor block
cohort: 60 patients with mild pregnancy-induced hypertension undergoing elective or semi-emergency cesarean section.
finding: The addition of intrathecal magnesium sulfate to levobupivacaine during cesarean section for patients with mild pregnancy-induced hypertension prolonged spinal anesthesia duration and reduced postoperative analgesic consumption without significant hemodynamic effects.
